description: This Kotlin source file defines the SettingsFragment class for an Android app. It manages the app's settings screen, displaying permission statuses, and providing navigation to other screens like the Permissions Center and Help. It interacts with PermissionsManager to handle permission-related logic.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that provides an interface for configuring app settings, displaying permission statuses, and navigating to other parts of the app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the settings fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up click listeners, and binds permission statuses.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the activity title and refreshes permission statuses when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: bindPermissionStatuses
methods.description: Fetches permission statuses using PermissionsManager and updates UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Converts a PermissionStatus object to a user-readable string.
